note: Narration for the SeePat demo. Each line is anchored to a recorded beat plus an offset, so the voice follows the actual take instead of a guessed timeline. Offsets are chosen so no line overlaps the next (tools/build-video.mjs reports overlaps). 'max' is the window the line has to fit; tools/make-narration-kokoro.mjs synthesizes, measures, and speeds up only as much as that window requires.

steps.card: The money, today - real profit, not sales
The ledger - every benta, utang, gastos
Asking the ledger in your own words
The voice model on the phone

lines.text: SeePat.
Don't just record your tindahan. Understand it.
So how does it work?
Seven steps, end to end.
In the Philippines, over a million sari-sari stores run on memory and guesswork.
It opens on today's real profit, not today's sales.
Every benta, utang and gastos is recorded in one ledger.
Sale, utang, gastos, capital: all first-class entries.
Sipat, nakabenta ako ng sampung Coke.
Speak the sale in Taglish. No forms, no typing.
SeePat prices it from your history and drafts it. You confirm.
Then ask in your own words.
Nasaan ang puhunan ko? Where is my capital?
Every figure comes from your own ledger, not from a language model.
The SeePat Score grades the business out of one hundred.
Every point is explained, in your own numbers.
The voice model downloads once, then it lives on the phone.
No signal? It still records, and it still answers.
Voice runs on the phone itself, and your data never leaves it.
SeePat. Don't just record it. Understand it.
